summary: BW LPG Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the completed sale of its 8.50% equity stake in Confidence Petroleum India Limited (CPIL). The press release states the sale marks BW LPG's full exit as a shareholder, following an earlier announcement on 20 May 2025 regarding cessation of infrastructure investments in India. No price per share, total value, or premium was disclosed; the investment was classified as an equity investment with fair value changes recognized before sale, resulting in no impact on profit/loss or total equity. The transaction appears to be a straightforward market sale of a non-controlling interest. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock mentioned. What to watch: further details on proceeds may emerge in subsequent filings; the absence of financial impact suggests a passive exit.
